info.title: Cartesia Realtime Speech-to-Text WebSocket API
info.description:
Realtime speech transcription without turn detection

<Note>
  Send the `finalize` command to trigger transcription. See [Compare STT Endpoints](/use-the-api/stt/compare-endpoints) for details.
</Note>

sample_rate.description: The sample rate of the audio in Hz, from 8000 to 48000

language_hint.description:
Used by `ink-preview` only. `ink-2` returns an error.

A language to steer transcription toward. Hints don't stop the model from transcribing other languages.

To pass several, repeat the `language_hint` query parameter. You can pass up to 6. Use base codes from [Languages](/use-the-api/stt/languages), such as `pt`, not `pt-BR`. `language_hints` is also accepted as an alias.

Example: `?language_hint=hi&language_hint=en`

See [Languages](/use-the-api/stt/languages#language-hints) for details.

language.description:
Used by `ink-whisper` models only. Leave it out with `ink-2` and `ink-preview`, which detect the language automatically. To steer `ink-preview` toward a language, use `language_hint`.

With `ink-whisper`, set this to the language code of the audio. If you leave it out, it defaults to `en`, and speech in other languages can come back translated into English.

See [Older models](/build-with-cartesia/stt/older-models#ink-whisper) for all options.

min_volume.description:
Used by `ink-whisper` models only.

Sets what counts as silence when the API finalizes transcripts automatically. Range: 0.0–1.0.

Lower values pick up quiet audio.
Higher values filter noisy audio more.

max_silence_duration_secs.description:
Used by `ink-whisper` models only.

The longest silence, in seconds, before the API finalizes the transcript automatically.

Lower values finalize transcripts sooner.
Higher values allow longer pauses within an utterance.

keyterm.description:
Used by `ink-2` and `ink-preview` only.

Key terms that help the model recognize specific words and phrases.

To pass several, repeat the `keyterm` query parameter. `ink-preview` accepts up to 500 keyterms totaling 5,000 characters. `ink-2` accepts up to 100 totaling 1,200. To boost one multi-word phrase, join the words with `%20`. `keyterms` is accepted as an alias.

URLs longer than about 8 KB are rejected with HTTP 414. With `ink-preview`, send long lists in a `config` message after you connect.

Example: `?keyterm=Ink%202&keyterm=Cartesia`

See [Keyterm prompting](/use-the-api/stt/keyterms) for details.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: API key for trusted server applications.

accessToken.name: access_token
accessToken.description: Short-lived token for browser and mobile applications.

STTAudioData.name: STTAudioData
STTAudioData.title: Send Audio Data
STTAudioData.description:
Send raw audio as binary WebSocket messages, in small chunks such as 100 ms.

The audio must match the `encoding` and `sample_rate` query parameters.

STTFinalizeCommand.name: STTFinalizeCommand
STTFinalizeCommand.title: Finalize Command
STTFinalizeCommand.description:
Send `finalize` as a text message when the user has finished speaking. You get the transcript for any audio still buffered.

The JSON form `{"type": "finalize"}` also works.

STTCloseCommand.name: STTCloseCommand
STTCloseCommand.title: Close Command
STTCloseCommand.description:
Send `close` as a text message to flush the remaining audio and close the session. The server replies with `done`.

The JSON form `{"type": "close"}` also works.

STTConfigCommand.name: STTConfigCommand
STTConfigCommand.title: Config Command
STTConfigCommand.description: Change keyterms or language hints mid-stream (`ink-preview` only)

STTTranscriptResponse.name: STTTranscriptResponse
STTTranscriptResponse.title: Transcript Response
STTTranscriptResponse.description:
Transcript chunks.

Send the `finalize` command when the user has finished speaking to get these chunks. The API can also send chunks before you send `finalize`.

STTErrorResponse.name: STTErrorResponse
STTErrorResponse.title: Error Response
STTErrorResponse.description: Error information for STT WebSocket connections

STTAudioData.description: Raw audio as a binary message, in the format set by the `encoding` parameter. Send it in small chunks, such as 100 ms.

STTFinalizeCommand.description: The value `finalize` as a text message

STTCloseCommand.description: The value `close` as a text message

type.description:
Command type. Send this as a JSON formatted WebSocket text message. `ink-preview` only.

Changes take effect right away, including for words not returned yet. There's no reply on success. An invalid message returns an `error` event, changes nothing, and leaves the connection open.

keyterms.description:
`ink-preview` only. Replaces the session's keyterms. `[]` clears them, and leaving the field out keeps them. The limits are the same as at connect time.

See [Change keyterms mid-stream](/use-the-api/stt/keyterms#change-keyterms-mid-stream).

language_hints.description:
`ink-preview` only. Replaces the session's language hints, up to 6. `[]` clears them, and leaving the field out keeps them.

See [Change hints mid-stream](/use-the-api/stt/languages#change-hints-mid-stream).

STTConfigCommand.description: Change keyterms or language hints mid-stream (`ink-preview` only)

request_id.description: Unique identifier for this WebSocket connection

text.description:
Text transcribed since the last chunk with `"is_final": true`.

To build the full transcript, concatenate the `text` of every chunk where `"is_final": true`.

Don't strip whitespace from `text` or add whitespace between chunks. Either one produces an incorrect transcript.

duration.description: Duration of the audio in seconds

words.description:
Word-level timestamps, from `ink-preview` and `ink-whisper`. `ink-2` doesn't return them.

With `ink-preview`, each event lists only the words completed since the previous event. A word's timestamps can arrive in a later event than its text, sometimes in an event with empty `text`. Left out when there are none. See [Word timestamps](/use-the-api/stt/word-timestamps).

word.description: The word with any punctuation attached. `ink-whisper` words can start with a space.

start.description: Start time in seconds, counted from the start of the audio sent on the connection

end.description: End time in seconds, counted from the start of the audio sent on the connection

STTTranscriptResponse.description:
Transcript chunks.

Send the `finalize` command when the user has finished speaking to get these chunks. The API can also send chunks before you send `finalize`.

request_id.description: Unique identifier for this WebSocket connection

languages.description:
`ink-preview` only. Languages detected at this `finalize`, highest confidence first. Detection looks at the most recent audio, so this can include audio from before the previous `finalize`. Left out when no audio arrived since then.

See [Detected languages](/use-the-api/stt/languages#detected-languages).

confidence.description: How confident the model is that this language was spoken, from 0 (not confident) to 1 (very confident).

is_final.description: Has no meaning for this message

request_id.description: Unique identifier for this WebSocket connection

languages.description:
`ink-preview` only. Languages detected in audio sent after the last `finalize`, highest confidence first. Detection looks at the most recent audio, so this can include earlier audio. Left out when no audio arrived since then.

See [Detected languages](/use-the-api/stt/languages#detected-languages).

confidence.description: How confident the model is that this language was spoken, from 0 (not confident) to 1 (very confident).

is_final.description: Has no meaning for this message

request_id.description: Unique identifier for this WebSocket connection

STTErrorResponse.description: Error information for STT WebSocket connections

SpeechToTextModel.description:
ID of the model to use for transcription.

See [Models](/build-with-cartesia/stt/latest) for details.

SpeechToTextEncoding.description:
The encoding of the raw audio you send. The server uses it to read your audio.

For help choosing an encoding, see [Audio Input](/build-with-cartesia/stt/audio-input).
